scope: Specification consistency checks only; no container reader, writer, conversion or inference implementation is claimed.

layout_checks.method: Parse numeric offset/size rows from each Markdown layout table; assert each field begins at the preceding field end and the final byte count matches the specified size.

header_hash_check.method: Build a 256-byte header buffer, compute SHA-256 with bytes [176,208) zero, insert digest, zero that field again and verify digest equality.
header_hash_check.limitation: Checks hash-field mechanics, not validity of a complete model file.
